## Import GDS and Build the HFSS/Q3D/Q2D Model

The canonical OrcaPen getter supplies actual placed polygon exteriors, holes,
source occurrences, physical levels and materials. This cell only adopts the
explicit case Net grouping and constructs SCGSim's public input records.
It does not infer connectivity or register invented children.
This cell constructs source input; actual native import/build belongs to the
later CLI transaction, not this source observation.

The background recipe records the existing `px`, `py`, `pz` margins as the
surrounding vacuum complement. Its bounds are already padded; the recipe does
not add those margins to the background a second time.

```{python}
#| id: tsv-owner-source-input
if WORKFLOW_ACTION not in {"analyze_handoff", "inspect_model"}:
    bounds = coupon.dbbox()
    regions = coupon.info["tsv_source"]["source_regions"]
    source_bottom = min(r["z_interval_um"][0] for r in regions)
    source_top = max(r["z_interval_um"][1] for r in regions)
    px, py, pz = REGION_PADDING_XYZ_UM
    background = {
        "semantic_id": "CALLER_BACKGROUND",
        "role": "solution_region",
        "material_id": "vacuum",
        "material_kind": "vacuum",
        "priority": 99,
        "geometry_kind": "domain",
        "geometry": {
            "domain_bounds_um": {
                "x_min_um": bounds.left - px,
                "x_max_um": bounds.right + px,
                "y_min_um": bounds.bottom - py,
                "y_max_um": bounds.top + py,
            },
            "z_min_um": source_bottom - pz,
            "z_max_um": source_top + pz,
        },
        "metadata": {
            "meaning": "computational background complement",
            "is_auto_vacuum_region": True,
            "vacuum_region_padding_um": {
                "x_minus_um": px,
                "x_plus_um": px,
                "y_minus_um": py,
                "y_plus_um": py,
                "z_minus_um": pz,
                "z_plus_um": pz,
            },
        },
    }
    source = get_tsv_source_records(coupon, host_solution_region=background)
    caller_nets = {
        **dict.fromkeys(SIGNAL_ENTITY_IDS, "Signal"),
        **dict.fromkeys(GROUND_ENTITY_IDS, "Ground"),
    }
    records = source["geometry_input"]
    stack = source["stack"]
    for layer in stack["layers"]:
        layer["net_id"] = caller_nets[layer["semantic_id"]]
    # Keep physical material records; add only the compiler's kind vocabulary.
    geometry_kinds = {
        "superconductor": "conductor",
        "dielectric": "dielectric",
        "vacuum": "vacuum",
    }
    stack["materials"] = {
        name: {
            **record,
            "kind": geometry_kinds[record["material_kind"]],
            "permittivity": record["relative_permittivity"],
        }
        for name, record in stack["materials"].items()
    }
    build_input = GeometryBuildInput(
        polygons=tuple(LayoutPolygonSpec(**p) for p in records["polygons"]),
        entities=tuple(
            SemanticEntitySpec(**{**e, "net_id": caller_nets.get(e["semantic_id"])})
            for e in records["entities"]
        ),
        solution_regions=records["solution_regions"],
        metadata={**records["metadata"], "caller_final_nets": caller_nets},
    )
    display(
        {
            "source_parameters": coupon.info["tsv_source"]["parameters"],
            "source_contacts": records["metadata"]["source_contacts"],
            "source_ports": records["metadata"]["source_ports"],
            "caller_nets": caller_nets,
            "physical_layer_declarations": {
                e.semantic_id: e.metadata["physical_layer"]
                for e in build_input.entities
                if e.material_kind == "conductor"
            },
        }
    )
```

## Geometry Verification

These are source observations. Silicon already has the authored bore holes;
the TSV wall is an annulus, not a filled cylinder. In `thin_film`, face films
follow their declared contact side while TSV `retained_solid` levels stay
finite. SCGSim owns the effective-Z mapping and the actual backend geometry.
The current AEDT path consumes sampled GDS polygon witnesses; exact circular
recipes remain source intent, not active native curve reconstruction.

### Fresh source witness

```{python}
#| id: tsv-source-gds
if WORKFLOW_ACTION in {"run", "prepare_handoff", "build_model"}:
    SOURCE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    gds_path = coupon.write_gds(SOURCE_DIR / "source.gds", with_metadata=False)
    gds_bytes = Path(gds_path).read_bytes()
    gds_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(gds_bytes).hexdigest()
    stack["metadata"]["gds_sha256"] = gds_sha256
    build_input = replace(build_input, metadata={**build_input.metadata, "gds_sha256": gds_sha256})
```

The exported witness and normalized source records come from the same component.
The backend helper owns actual lowering; this notebook does not interpret a
source GDS hash as an actual native geometry observation.

## Materials and Boundaries

Al and TiN remain the physical source materials; their PDK superconducting
declarations select ideal native conductor treatment. Silicon is a perforated
dielectric solid. The caller-authored background is the surrounding complement,
not a second overlapping occupied body. Final Nets are the explicit grouping
above, not a connectivity result inferred by the notebook.

## Simulation Setup

The notebook's explicit run control selects the Human-confirmed first-trial
physics settings before preparation. `build_model` alone passes
`run_control=None` for the candidate's model-only transaction, without an
Analysis Setup or sweep. The getter now carries the same selected neutral
`physical_layer` declaration on Entity and stack records. Shared interpretation
belongs to SCGSim, not notebook arithmetic. Read-only returned-run
actions skip every component/getter/GDS/preparation stage above.
